answers.core:
There is already an addon called [gdfxr](https://github.com/timothyqiu/gdfxr) for this job.

This implementation's advantage is being more lightweight because It does not create, fill a buffer and pass it to the audio server, but it simulates oscillators and generates a new audio frame when audio server requests. However, this feature may not be user friendly if its UI is not improved by a graph based audio splitting/mixing UI as explained in [Proposal 3394](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/3394).
answers.workaround:
It can be worked around by using [AudioStreamGenerator](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_audiostreamgenerator.html#class-audiostreamgenerator)

It is advantageous for users without signal or audio processing experience.
